changeSet.author: nexus-syfes.1
changeSet.comment: CREATE OR REPLACE nexus.gc_quarantine_orphans: same signature and return shape as catalog-023-1. Only change: the quarantine sibling's catalog_collections stub is now inserted inside each dim branch, guarded by the existing "IF v_chashes IS NULL THEN RETURN" early-out, so a zero-orphan pass over a clean collection never registers its unused quarantine sibling.

changeSet.author: nexus-syfes.2
changeSet.comment: CREATE OR REPLACE nexus.gc_restore_rereferenced: same signature and return shape as catalog-023-2. Only change: the origin collection's catalog_collections stub is now inserted inside each dim branch, guarded by the existing "IF v_chashes IS NULL THEN RETURN 0" early-out, so a zero-match restore pass never registers an origin collection that has never received anything back from quarantine.
